Situation: Fluconazole has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-01-13, a duration of 57 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 164 units (13 days at 12.8/day). Corvale General holds 289 units (18 days at 16.4/day). Our current product (NDC 51407042430) is labeled by Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. (FEI 3006458969) and manufactured by Novitium Pharma LLC (FEI 3012541241).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows fluconazole in shortage continuously since 2022-01-13. FDA inspected Novitium Pharma LLC and classified the inspection VAI on 2019-02-04 (letter dated 2019-04-03), 1,074 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspected Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. with an OAI classification on 2011-02-02 and a Warning Letter on 2011-04-26. The most recent inspections were NAI: Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. on 2025-06-11 and Novitium Pharma LLC on 2024-02-16.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at both campuses. The rule-based best option is A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an emergency order with A-S Medication Solutions and confirm delivery timeline; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as a secondary source and place a contingent order; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to verify labeler and manufacturing plant information for all alternative suppliers before receipt; requires Quality Assurance approval.
4. Buyer to report daily inventory levels to the P&T Committee until both campuses exceed 30 days on hand; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA list updates; relying solely on current labeler given inspection history; splitting orders across multiple unvetted suppliers without plant verification.
